title: Card for my mother (patterns and flowers, no people)
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: Similar-sounding letters; the four seasons; my mother
source: Seeded from arabic/y4 lesson 16 (Pupil PDF worksheet: card for my mother (patterns and flowers, no people))
intro: Lesson 16: My mother: kindness to parents. To understand how to talk about my mother in Arabic and why Islam teaches kindness to parents

questions.q: Say: I love my mother and I help her.
questions.model: Teacher: أُحِبُّ أُمِّي (I love my mother) + وَ (and) + أُسَاعِدُهَا (I help her). The ـهَا means 'her'.

questions.q: Write a card on the pupil PDF for your mother or carer (patterns and flowers, no people): three Arabic sentences (what she does, I love her, I help her) and the du'a رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا.
questions.a: Three correct sentences and the du'a copied with harakat
questions.model: Teacher writes sentence 1: أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ طَعَامًا لَذِيذًا (my mother cooks tasty food).

questions.q: say one thing you will do for your mother this week in Arabic.
questions.a: For example: أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي فِي المَطْبَخِ

questions.q: Who did the Prophet ﷺ name three times?
Back to our ponder: who most deserves our good company?
questions.a: Your mother, three times, then your father
